OK-2026-SB563.aiSummary: The bill changes how county planning commissions and county boards of adjustment are set up. It would make the county commission chair, or a designee, a member of the planning commission, shorten member terms, and set the board of adjustment at three, five, or seven county resident property owners with shorter terms. It also lets county commissioners hire private legal counsel for the board of adjustment and says older county planning and zoning actions stay in effect until changed.
